descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-13 step 1; TFA-92591 AC 1 · “Paste a prior note for one patient; photograph a prior note for another”. Mixed: stated part — Paste on one patient and photo on another each update only that patient's chart; our part — Switching patient while the read or extraction is still running (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S27 Two Hospital patients: a photo on one, a paste on the other, and switching patient while 'Reading' or 'Extracting'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled … (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 6; TFA-92591 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with two synthetic Hospital patients A and B on one list (UAT step 1: paste for one patient, photograph for another)

When (1) On A press Photograph, upload the S03 image, and open B while the button says Reading; return to A, review the text, date 'Oct 11', Save & Extract. (2) On B paste note B dated 'Oct 11', press Save & Extract and open A before it finishes; return to B

Then (1) B's note box is empty and B's chart has none of 'CKD', 'EF 30', 'pleural effusion'. After Save & Extract on A, A shows 'pleural effusion' and no vital from the note. (2) A's chart has none of 'lower lobe', 'consolidation', 'procalcitonin'. B's chart shows 'lower lobe' or 'consolidation'. Neither chart shows 142/88 or 110/64

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Each patient's own facts are positive controls, and the other patient's facts plus both notes' vitals are mustNotContain. 'pneumonia' is not used as a check, because the fixture patient's diagnosis already contains it

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
